message:
fix: detach only JNI thread attachments owned by the guard

Remember when JEnv successfully attaches a detached native thread and detach
that attachment on scope exit. Leave Java-owned and already-attached threads
alone. Disable ownership copying and moving to avoid duplicate detachment;
the existing factory retains mandatory C++17 return-value elision.

Related: #2170
